rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose way to say that a plan, proposal, or idea is not feasible.

example.english: This plan is too rushed, so it is completely unfeasible.
example.traditional: 呢個計劃太趕，根本唔可行。
example.jyutping: nei1 go3 gai3 waak6 taai3 gon2 gan1 bun2 m4 ho2 hang4

rows.note: Choose this when the idea is impractical or unrealistic rather than simply technically impossible.

example.english: It is unfeasible for one person to visit all of Hong Kong in one day.
example.traditional: 一個人想喺一日內行勻全香港，實在唔實際。
example.jyutping: jat1 go3 jan4 soeng2 hai2 jat1 jat6 noi6 haang4 wan4 cyun4 hoeng1 gong2 sat6 zoi6 m4 sat6 zai3

rows.note: Use this when a method, route, or proposed solution will not work.

example.english: This method is unfeasible because it requires shutting down all the machines first.
example.traditional: 呢個方法要停晒部機先做，根本行唔通。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 fong1 faat3 jiu3 ting4 saai3 bou6 gei1 sin1 zou6 gan1 bun2 haang4 m4 tung1
